explanation: Kal single-leg squats add kiye the aur aaj swelling kal se zyada hai, isliye aaj lighter day rakhte hain: heel slides, quad sets, straight-leg raises aur ice + elevation, aur single-leg squats aur stationary bike aaj skip karna. Stairs pe khichav ya swelling ke baare mein apne physio ko zaroor bata dena.
